dialogues.speaker: Moyan
dialogues.text: I'm Moyan, the village accountant. I sometimes also help the others with odd jobs here and there.

dialogues.speaker: Moyan
dialogues.text: Our merchants often pass through here, and I ask after their businesses every day.

dialogues.speaker: Moyan
dialogues.text: I also visit every family in the village every month, so I have a good idea of how we're doing financially.
